subject: GreenLeaf marketplace listing — assurance evidence & DPA coordination
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@greenleaf.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GreenLeaf marketplace listing: evidence package and timeline

Hi Vivek / Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. GreenLeaf is preparing the AWS Marketplace co-sell intake and we need to collect the security/compliance packet so we can submit by the marketplace cutoff on Dec 16. Procurement asked for the following by Dec 10 so they can review before listing:

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted okay)
- A pen test attestation or letter from last 12 months
- A copy of the DPA we would sign (or a DocuSign link)
- A short statement on data residency & logging (where customer data is stored, retention, audit logs)

Is it possible for Redwood to provide a single zip with the above items? If not, please indicate where we should pull each item (S3, secure share link, or DocuSign). Also flag any items that require approvals.

Procurement contact is copied on this thread (procurement@greenleaf.com) — they may have specific vendor-id or upload instructions.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Moreno
Senior Partnerships Manager, GreenLeaf, Inc.
alice.moreno@greenleaf.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@greenleaf.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf marketplace listing: evidence package and timeline

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can meet the Dec 10 internal ask and aim to deliver a consolidated package. Quick notes and owners below: 

1) SOC 2 Type II (redacted): Kimberly will pull the redacted report and remove sensitive client identifiers. Expected delivery: Dec 3 (Kimberly).
2) Pen test attestation: We have an independent pen-test letter from Q2 2026. Kimberly will confirm scope (external/internal) and redaction level. Expected delivery: Dec 3.
3) DPA: Ben will prepare our standard marketplace DPA copy and send a DocuSign envelope if GreenLeaf prefers. If GreenLeaf has a counter-DPA, please attach it. Ben to own DocuSign.
4) Data residency & logging statement: I’ll draft a short paragraph describing our default regions, retention policy, and where audit logs are stored; I’ll include relevant links to our SOC control mappings.

Delivery options — we can: (a) upload a password-protected zip to a GreenLeaf S3 bucket (presigned URL), (b) share via our secure Drive link, or (c) send DocuSign for the DPA and S3/Drive for the artifacts. If Procurement requires vendor portal upload (AWS Marketplace portal), let us know and we’ll coordinate.

Action items: 
- Kimberly Park: assemble SOC2 redacted + pen test letter (Dec 3)
- Ben Carter: prepare DPA DocuSign and confirm signing flow (Dec 5)
- Vivek Kulkarni: draft data residency/logging paragraph and create the shared Drive folder (Dec 4)

I’ll send a short package email when artifacts are ready.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships (acting) — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0110

Vivek —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms they need artifacts by Dec 10 for security review and will push listing to AWS by Dec 16. A few notes from procurement: 

- Vendor intake form attached (GreenLeaf_Marketplace_Intake.pdf) — please populate vendor contact and vendor ID if available.
- For the DPA: we prefer DocuSign, and I’ll send the procurement-approved DPA language separately if needed.
- For the SOC2: redacted PDF is fine — they will not accept raw working papers.

I’m attaching the intake form and our vendor ID (GL-VEND-271). Also linking our procurement DocuSign workflow: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=abc123-greenleaf

Thanks — let me know if you need our procurement legal cc’d directly.

Best,
Alice

Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf marketplace listing: evidence package and timeline

Hi Alice / Procurement —

Per Vivek’s plan, attached are the artifacts we can share for the AWS Marketplace submission: 

- SOC2_Redacted_2025.pdf (redacted: client names & IP removed)
- PenTest_Letter_RedwoodOps_2026.pdf (high-level scope & attest)
- DPA_GreenLeaf_v1.docx (our standard DPA; Ben will send DocuSign)

We have uploaded the same package to a password-protected S3 bucket and created a secure Drive link. If procurement prefers direct portal upload, please provide the upload instructions or vendor portal credentials and we will push the files there. 

Quick summary for your reviewers: 
- Data residency: customer data for marketplace-provisioned customers is stored in the chosen cloud region (US-East or US-West) based on marketplace settings; backups are in the same region.
- Retention & logs: default logs retained for 90 days in audit logging; longer retention can be enabled per contract. Audit logs are stored in immutable object storage with access logging enabled.

Ben — can you send the DocuSign envelope for DPA_GreenLeaf_v1.docx and confirm signing order (GreenLeaf -> Redwood)?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Trust Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
